title: Transport intrinsic proper/open coherence through the section bridge
statement: Fix a prime l and a finite extension E of Q_l, Operations o and Compositors c [def-sf-integral-system-operations], OpenComparisons a for o,c, and CanonicalBridge b for o [def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge]. There exists ProperOpenCoherence for o,c,a,b [def-sf-integral-system-realization-data]: its gamma is the intrinsic semilinear gamma transported through b, has the specified properOpenLambda adjunct, and satisfies the displayed vertical, horizontal and cartesian base-change equations. There is no tensor conclusion.

source.place: Coefficient-comparison sentence; expanded strict-system realization argument, as recorded in lem-sf-integral-canonical-ambient-models.

proof.text: Define gamma by conjugating intrinsic semilinear gamma with the bridge push and shriek isomorphisms. Naturality and inverse cancellation give its canonical equation. Section normalization and adjoint uniqueness identify ordinary compositors; their fixed representative equations identify derived compositors. The specified open-unit transposes identify beta and the clopen comparison under the bridge.

source.place: Coefficient-comparison sentence; expanded strict-system realization argument, as recorded in lem-sf-integral-canonical-ambient-models.

proof.text: Transport every cartesian, restriction-factor and clopen/direct factor in lambda. The intrinsic lambda adjunct equation then gives precisely the adjunct field. Transport each of the three intrinsic mate-pasting equations; naturality moves the bridge maps to the endpoints and inverse cancellation gives the required equations in the derived system categories.
